systematic_floor.method: Catalog stars (aperture S/N>=20) in the matched region, assumed mostly constant: robust excess scatter beyond propagated errors; multiplicative term from S/N>=100 stars, additive term from fainter stars.

injection_recovery.method: PSF-shaped sources added to the real difference image at blank interior positions; detection rerun with the production threshold.

target.reason: Target core pixels carry non-SOURCE quality flag bits [0, 1, 2, 26] (e.g. saturation/non-linearity); excluded by the mask policy.

limitations: Only pixels whose own-calibration CWAVE values agree within the policy tolerance are compared; elsewhere the epochs sample different wavelengths.
Bilinear reprojection and PSF cross-convolution correlate neighbouring pixels; per-pixel variances are marginal and the blank-sky null test only inflates them.
The spectral-mismatch term bounds |dlnF/dlnlambda| by the policy value; extreme spectra can exceed it.
Single detector-zone ePSFs are used at the field centre; PSF variation across the cutout contributes to the empirical systematic floor.
Catalog association is positional (Gaia DR3, G<=19, proper motion propagated, no parallax); candidates require independent follow-up.

catalog.adql: SELECT TOP 5001 source_id,ra,dec,pmra,pmdec,ref_epoch,phot_variable_flag,duplicated_source,bp_rp,ruwe,phot_g_mean_mag,ra_error,dec_error,pmra_error,pmdec_error,parallax,parallax_error FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',269.4463051973687,4.767723693726218,0.2)) AND phot_g_mean_mag<=19.0 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

magnitude_selection.status: Explicit sample selection, not catalog completeness guarantee

catalog.variability_policy: Exclude VARIABLE; unknown variability does not prove constancy.
catalog.quality_policy: Exclude duplicates/missing required astrometry/color/photometry. RUWE preserved without invented cutoff.
limitations: Catalog sources are candidate references only.
No image blending/saturation or infrared variability screen is established by Gaia alone.
Neighbors fainter than the explicit Gaia G magnitude selection are not represented.
